rule.unit_selection: all source_annotations[*].obligation_units[*] in the exact source artifact
rule.acceptance_boundary: one reviewed obligation_unit equals one projected migration/reconciliation governing acceptance; no cross-unit batching is assumed
rule.effect_proxy: each proposition inside an obligation_unit is counted as one projected governing effect for the distribution estimate
rule.repeated_signing_count: one owner proof per projected acceptance in the baseline migration pass
